authorization.credential_source: QISKIT_IBM_TOKEN or an explicitly saved QiskitRuntimeService account

backend.selection_rule: least_busy operational non-simulator backend with at least 5 qubits, resolved once at execution start

circuits.selection_rule: first deterministic scan cell with hybrid reduction >= 0.05 and at least one removed two-qubit gate
circuits.role: primary reducible random circuit; selected depth and seed are recorded in metadata

sampling.seed_policy: real-device repetitions are independent jobs; no simulator seed is claimed

pre_registered_predictions.ghz_n4: All optimizer versions are structurally identical; optimizer gain is expected to be zero.
pre_registered_predictions.oracle_bv_n4_level_0: Reduced versions may improve sampled fidelity through fewer logical one-qubit operations, subject to routing and device noise.
pre_registered_predictions.oracle_bv_n4_level_1: The backend transpiler may absorb the logical one-qubit reduction; no positive hardware gain is required.
pre_registered_predictions.interpretation: These are directional predictions and do not authorize causal claims from a single backend.

success_criteria: For each circuit with positive post-transpile two-qubit reduction, optimized noisy Hellinger fidelity is no lower than original within two standard errors at the same backend and transpilation level.
GHZ dominant-mode mass is at least 0.5, otherwise classify the entanglement-witness criterion as failed without retuning.
BV success probability differs from the matched fake-backend prediction by no more than 0.15.
All three repetitions are retained; missing jobs are classified rather than silently excluded.
stop_rules: Stop and classify UNAVAILABLE if no eligible operational backend can be selected.
Stop and classify AUTHENTICATION_FAILURE for missing or rejected credentials.
Stop and classify JOB_FAILURE or PARTIAL_EXECUTION for runtime submission/result failures; do not replace failed jobs after inspecting outcomes.
Do not add circuits, versions, shots, repetitions, backends, or metrics after the first result is observed.
